mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", code AS "code", name AS "name", category AS "category", direction AS "direction", note AS "note", COALESCE(active, 1) AS "active", sort_order AS "sortOrder" FROM acc_subject ORDER BY sort_order NULLS FIRST, code NULLS FIRST, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acc_subject WHERE code = #{code} AND id <> #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acc_subject (code, name, category, direction, note, active, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{category}, #{direction}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{active}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM acc_subject), #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", bank_name AS "bankName", account_no AS "accountNo", holder AS "holder", purpose AS "purpose", note AS "note", COALESCE(active, 1) AS "active", sort_order AS "sortOrder" FROM acc_bank_account ORDER BY sort_order NULLS FIRST, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acc_bank_account (bank_name, account_no, holder, purpose, note, active, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{bankName}, #{accountNo}, #{holder, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{purpose, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{active}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM acc_bank_account), #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acc_card WHERE bank_account_id = #{id}

SELECT c.id AS "id", c.issuer AS "issuer", c.last4 AS "last4", c.nickname AS "nickname", c.holder AS "holder", c.bank_account_id AS "bankAccountId", c.note AS "note", COALESCE(c.active, 1) AS "active", c.sort_order AS "sortOrder", b.bank_name AS "payBank", b.account_no AS "payAccountNo" FROM acc_card c LEFT JOIN acc_bank_account b ON b.id = c.bank_account_id ORDER BY c.sort_order NULLS FIRST, c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acc_card (issuer, last4, nickname, holder, bank_account_id, note, active, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{issuer}, #{last4}, #{nickname, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{holder, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{bankAccountId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{active}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM acc_card), #{now})
